name: Ich schau dir in die Augen, gesellschaftlicher Verblendungszusammenhang!
description: René Pollesch's first production of 2010 (referenced in a retrospective context for 2026) features Fabian Hinrichs in a solo ninety-minute performance. The work picks apart the 'Verblendungszusammenhang' (ideological obfuscation) that keeps us attached to constructs like 'sense,' 'soul,' 'love,' and 'origin' despite poststructuralist theory. Pollesch argues that sense is absent, the soul is merely 'an external relationship of the body with itself,' we only fall in love because we've read about it, and origin is a chimera. The piece challenges comfortable worldview illusions with Pollesch's signature intellectual provocation and theatrical energy.
